title: Harmit Singh Joins Albertsons® Companies Board of Directors
summary: Albertsons® Companies announced that it has named Levi Strauss & Co. Chief Financial and Growth Officer Harmit Singh to its board of directors.
body_markdown:
Unzipped Staff
Levi Strauss & Co.


October 15, 2026


Today, Albertsons® Companies, one of the largest food and drug retailers in the U.S., announced that it has named Levi Strauss & Co. Chief Financial and Growth Officer Harmit Singh to its board of directors.


“I am honored to join Albertsons’ Board of Directors,” said Harmit. “Albertsons has a strong legacy, a portfolio of trusted brands and a clear commitment to serving customers and communities. I look forward to working with my fellow directors and the leadership team to support the company’s continued growth and strategic priorities.”


Harmit brings more than 40 years of global financial, operational and strategic leadership experience across some of the world’s most recognized consumer, retail and hospitality brands, bringing meaningful value to the Albertsons® Companies board of directors.


For more information, see the[press release](https://www.albertsonscompanies.com/newsroom/press-releases/news-details/2026/Albertsons-Companies-Inc--Appoints-Harmit-Singh-to-Board-of-Directors/default.aspx) .
